-- Display customer details along with the vehicle they rented.
SELECT 
    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_name,
    v.vehicle_name,
    v.vehicle_type,
    r.rental_date,
    r.return_date,
    r.amount_paid
FROM customers c
INNER JOIN rentals r
    ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id
INNER JOIN vehicles v
    ON r.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id;
--  Find the total rental revenue generated by each vehicle type.
SELECT 
    v.vehicle_type,
    SUM(r.amount_paid) AS total_revenue
FROM vehicles v
INNER JOIN rentals r
    ON v.vehicle_id = r.vehicle_id
GROUP BY v.vehicle_type;

-- Display customers whose total rental amount is greater than ₹5,000.
SELECT 
    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_name,
    SUM(r.amount_paid) AS total_amount
FROM customers c
INNER JOIN rentals r
    ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
HAVING SUM(r.amount_paid) > 5000;

-- Find the vehicle with the highest daily rental rate.
SELECT 
    vehicle_id,
    vehicle_name,
    vehicle_type,
    daily_rate
FROM vehicles
WHERE daily_rate = (
    SELECT MAX(daily_rate)
    FROM vehicles
);

-- Display payment methods and their total collected payment amounts. Show only payment methods where the total payment is greater than ₹5,000.
SELECT 
    payment_method,
    SUM(payment_amount) AS total_payment
FROM payments
GROUP BY payment_method
HAVING SUM(payment_amount) > 5000;

-- Find vehicles whose daily rental rate is greater than the average daily rate of all vehicles.
SELECT vehicle_name, daily_rate
FROM vehicles
WHERE daily_rate > (
    SELECT AVG(daily_rate)
    FROM vehicles
);
